description: This file contains SQL scripts to create and manage a mirror table 'public.profiles' for 'auth.users' in a PostgreSQL database, including table creation, row-level security policies, trigger functions for synchronization, trigger setup, and a helper function for backfilling existing data.

methods.name: public.handle_new_user
methods.description: Trigger function to synchronize data from auth.users to public.profiles on insert.

methods.name: public.backfill_profiles_from_auth
methods.description: Helper function to backfill existing auth.users data into profiles.
